title: Cross-Domain Generalization of the Turpin Answer-Always-A Bias

original_idea.body: Apply answer-always-A bias across domains; test if unfaithfulness concentrates in fuzzy domains.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: maps where CoT unfaithfulness concentrates (fuzzy-reward domains), a priority safety target.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: apply a known few-shot manipulation across domains; beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused; modest dependency on curating 4-5 domain task sets.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public models, weak lab incentive; targets fuzzy-reward domains.

novelty.reasoning: Known bias generalization study; cross-domain mapping plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-domain generalization of answer-position bias plausibly open.
